Ethan P.: hey team quick check 1 the calendar event for orientation doesn't show a passcode or agenda. can someone confirm link + materials? :slightly_smiling_face:
Onboarding Bot: Hi Ethan! Official Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 (passcode: `RiInclude2026`). Agenda + slides: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_example_onboarding.ICS for adding to other calendars: https://redwood.app/ical/onboarding_session.ics :calendar:
Priya S.: thanks bot. also wondering if breakout rooms will be used? i'm hearing some teams do intros in small groups.
Nina M.: yes, we'll do two 15-min breakout rounds for team intros and buddy meetups. breakout rooms will be pre-assigned by team. if you need captioning, enable "Live Transcript" in Zoom or toggle CC in the toolbar.
Carlos V.: will the session be recorded and will transcripts be available? sometimes captions are lost in breakout rooms.
Onboarding Bot: The main session will be recorded and auto-transcribed. Recordings + transcript will be uploaded to Drive and linked in #new-hires after processing (expected ~1 hour post-session). Note: breakout room audio is not included in the main transcript; request an attendee to record locally if you need that capture.
Ethan P.: perfect. timezone sanity check for folks joining remotely: the invite shows 11:00 AM ET 1 = 8:00 AM PT = 16:00 CET = 00:30 IST (next day). can someone confirm APAC conversions?
Nina M.: for APAC we have: AEST (Sydney) 02:00 next day, NZDT (Auckland) 04:00 next day, IST 00:30 next day. i'll paste a pinned note in the event with these conversions.
Priya S.: one tiny calendar nuisance: if you see two invites, accept the one from "People Ops / Onboarding" and decline any from other-team organizers. that fixed dupes for me.
Carlos V.: how do i get assigned my onboarding buddy? haven't seen an email.
Nina M.: buddy assignments go out ~24h before the session. if you still don't have one an hour prior, DM me and i'll sort it.
Ethan P.: thanks everyone, got the links and conversions. see you tomorrow! :wave:
